1.bug_scenario: The current implementation of the FormGroup component only allows the legendText prop to be a string. When a React node (e.g., a Tooltip component wrapping the label) is passed for legendText to provide additional help information, a prop-type validation warning occurs and the rendering is not as intended. The feature request is to enhance FormGroup so that the legendText prop can also accept React nodes (objects), like Tooltip, not just plain strings. This enables richer UI options for group legends.
